title: UI Polish + Arabic SEO — auth redesign with logo, fancy animated courses/learn pages, articles SEO with OG images
task: 1) Redesign auth pages (login/register/forgot/reset + layout) to match site visual language and use the real itqan_logo.png. 2) Enhance courses list, course details, and learn (video list/lesson) pages: fancier, animated, cool — same warm parchment/terracotta theme. 3) Enhance SEO, Arabic-first: articles pages get server metadata + Article JSON-LD + per-article og:image (cover photo in link previews), sitemap/robots coverage, branded OG image with real logo, manifest icons.
constraints: Theme locked: #f5f4ed bg, #faf9f5 card, #141413 dark, #c96442 primary, #d97757 accent, #b55836 hover, #e8e6dc sand, #f0eee6 border, #5e5d59/#87867f text, #30302e dark surface
framer-motion v12 installed; HomeClient.tsx fadeUp/staggerParent are the canonical animation patterns; respect prefers-reduced-motion
RTL: default locale ar; new spacing must use logical props (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/start-/end-); .ltr-flex utility exists
No backend changes; keep all existing data fetching, forms, auth logic intact

messages/en.json + ar.json already contain all needed keys (lesson.yourProgress, lesson.progressOf, lesson.courseContent, seo.articles, seo.articleFallback, seo.muqtatafat) — agents must NOT edit message files
Icons already generated: public/icon-192.png, icon-512.png, apple-touch-icon.png

stories.title: Articles + muqtatafat SEO: server metadata, Article JSON-LD, og:image from cover, sitemap, robots
acceptanceCriteria: /articles/page.tsx is a server component exporting generateMetadata (seo.articles i18n: title/description/keywords, canonical SITE_URL/articles, openGraph + twitter, locale-aware ar_SA/en_US) rendering the existing UI from a new client component file; CollectionPage JSON-LD with ItemList of published articles fetched server-side (pattern: courses/layout.tsx)

/articles/[slug]/page.tsx is a server component whose generateMetadata fetches the article server-side (BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL||NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL pattern) and emits: title=article title, description (article description or stripped content excerpt <=160 chars), openGraph type=article with publishedTime/modifiedTime/authors and og:image=coverImageUrl (absolute) with default OG fallback when no cover, twitter summary_large_image; falls back to seo.articleFallback + noindex when article missing

Article detail page injects Article JSON-LD (headline, description, image, datePublished, dateModified, author Person, publisher Organization with logo, mainEntityOfPage, inLanguage) AND BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (home > articles > article)
Existing client-side articles UI (search, rendering, markdown) still works unchanged after the server/client split
sitemap.ts includes /articles and per-article /articles/{slug} entries (lastModified from publishedAt) fetched from the public API; robots.ts allows /articles and /articles/*
muqtatafat gets a layout.tsx with generateMetadata using seo.muqtatafat keys (canonical, openGraph, twitter, locale-aware)
